_about: The repair engineer (league/engineer.py). Owner-only: no Merton role may write this file, so the engineer cannot raise its own ceiling. enabled=false stops every admission, follow-up and paid call (the free sources still report); jobs keep their state and resume when it is back on. Sept 22, 2026: one paid call per 15 minutes (was 30). Measured over its first live afternoon: four paid calls ($0.94 in all) produced two merged repairs (#100, #113), one honest 'no change justified' and one 'needs core authority', with 53 jobs admitted and waiting. The research gate saved about $4.66 an hour of research the same afternoon; this spends about $1 an hour of it on repairs. The per-job ceiling, the attempt limit and the frontier tiers are unchanged.
